notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF, matches prior Home-Decor pass note); robots.txt has generic 'User-agent: *' with SEO facet-param Disallow lines but no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-specific disallow -- proceeded. Site nav mega-menu (Huishouden section) has exactly one Pet-labeled branch: 'Huisdierbenodigdheden' (Pet Supplies) -> single link 'Dierenmeubels & accessoires' (Pet Furniture & Accessories), https://www.fonq.nl/collections/dierenmeubels-accessoires, nbResults=32 (evidence: v-text="nbResults">32 artikelen, baked into initial HTML, category-id 104085). This page embeds an exhaustive single-valued 'Type Product' facet (each product tagged with exactly one type) whose 4 values sum EXACTLY to 32 with no remainder: Dierenkussen=7, Dierenmand=2, Voer- en/of Drinkbak=11, Voerbak=12 -- used as the true leaf breakdown, parent kept as a grouping row (qty null) to avoid double-counting. 'Voerbak' additionally has its own dedicated crawlable collection page (https://www.fonq.nl/collections/voerbak) whose own nbResults=12 independently matches the facet count exactly, confirmed same product population via title sample (Alessi Tigrito Voerbak Kat, Alessi Lula Hondenvoerbak, Yamazaki Tower Voerbak/Voederbak, Eva Solo Luxe Voerbak) -- used as its link. The other 3 facet values (Dierenkussen, Dierenmand, Voer-en/of-Drinkbak) have no separate crawlable URL: tried ?type_product= query filtering on the parent URL, confirmed not applied server-side (still returns all 32, same pattern as a known fonQ platform limitation seen in the prior Home-Decor pass for 'lampenkap'), so their link is left null pending a working filter URL rather than pointed at the unfiltered parent. ADDITIONAL DISCOVERY VIA SITEMAP KEYWORD SWEEP (hond/kat/dieren/vogel/voerbak/krabpaal/halsband/aquarium etc. across all 5 sitemap.xml files, ~18M URLs total): found several more candidate SEO landing pages not present in the mega-menu -- hondenmand, hay-hondenmand, kattenbak, kattenmand, krabpaal, vogelvoederhuis, eva-solo-vogelvoederhuis all verified nbResults=0 (genuinely empty at check time, confirmed via the same v-text="nbResults">N pattern) -- dropped per zero-qty rule. EXCLUDED AS WRONG CATEGORY (site's own taxonomy, not Pet Care): vogelhuis (19), vogelvoederhuis-related 'vogelhuisjes-dierenverblijven' (62) -- both confirmed via homepage mobile-menu context to sit under 'Tuininrichting' (Garden Furnishing), sibling to Bloempotten/Buitenverlichting/Buitenkleden/Barbecues/Zwembaden, NOT under Huisdierbenodigdheden; product-title sample (Esschert Design nest boxes for woodpecker/owl/tit, bat house, dovecote) confirms these are wild-garden-bird/bat housing, not owned-pet products -- left in Garden per 'don't steal from other categories'. No pet grooming, walking/leash/collar, training, travel/carrier, clothing, litter (beyond the 0-qty kattenbak), or medical/consumable-food categories found anywhere on the site (targeted sitemap keyword sweep for halsband/hondenriem/hondentuig/kattenkrab/vogelkooi/aquarium/konijnenhok/cavia/hamster/trimsalon returned zero matches). fonQ is a general Dutch home/lifestyle retailer (platform 'Etrias') -- Pet Care is a small, single-branch part of its catalog, consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's characterization of the site.
